desc:
Welcome to the Sunset Savanna! An RPG where you can live out your dreams of being a lion or any other big cat. This game is published by Sylvistra, the studio behind Warrior Cats: Ultimate Edition.

Newest Update: 10/22🎃
- New Gamepasses added, view them in the store in the editor!
- Two new emotes: Nod & Head Shake!
- Free Accessories!

Controls: Q/E to change speeds. 
V to drop held item. 
Shift+P to toggle cinematic camera Animation hotkeys found ingame! 

⚠️ We do enact moderation enforcement if Roblox Community Standards are violated on both A Lion's Pride and A Wolves' Pack. Please follow these guidelines accordingly to not be reprimanded.
